channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: How hockey families build backyard ice rinks at three different price points
item.description: These Minnesotans have spent anywhere from hundreds to thousands of dollars for a place to skate close to home.

item.title: Takeaways from the US Justice Department’s initial release of Epstein files, mandated by Congress
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice on Friday published thousands of files related to Jeffrey Epstein, a release long anticipated for its potential to reveal new details about the late sex offender and his connections to powerful people.

item.title: The State Fair is months away, but crop artists are getting ready
item.description: The new monthly meetup, Crop Art Wednesdays in St. Paul, encourages people to meet, mingle and start making art.

item.title: World Junior Championship, launching pad for future NHL stars, arrives in Minnesota: ‘It’s the coolest thing ever’
item.description: Hockey’s annual 11-day under-20 showcase begins Dec. 26 with games at Grand Casino Arena and 3M Arena at Mariucci.

item.title: Ejection reveals a side of Timberwolves’ Chris Finch fans don’t always see
item.description: The coach, who said he wanted to make a point with his antics, is a fiery competitor, even if it always doesn’t show.

item.title: Minneapolis Council Member Ellison asked city to pay for flights to and from Harvard fellowship
item.description: Jeremiah Ellison has been mostly absent since August while attending a fellowship in Massachusetts.

item.title: Teachers in Minnesota’s largest school district authorize strike
item.description: Anoka-Hennepin teachers could strike in January as contract negotiations remain stalled.

item.title: Walz says there’s no evidence of $9B in fraud, exposing rift between state and feds
item.description: The statements exposed tensions that have been simmering between Walz and Joe Thompson, the federal prosecutor who has led the fraud investigations.

item.title: Vikings’ charter flight to Newark returns to MSP after mechanical issue
item.description: The Vikings took a later flight Saturday after their first plane turned around and flew back to the Twin Cities.

item.title: Anti-ICE protesters crowd Lake Street as ‘Operation Metro Surge’ continues
item.description: For weeks, federal immigration agents have focused enforcement in the Twin Cities and around Minnesota.
